name_reason: Fully compliant with the global naming convention: data_fd2_ prefix, battle core-table domain, descriptor summon_spell_palette_b accurately names the B (blue) VGA channel of the per-summon summon-spell palette, _table suffix reflects per-summon data. The trailing _b is a semantic R/G/B channel identifier (siblings _r @ 0x5254F, _g @ 0x52553), NOT Ghidra address residue (it is not a hex suffix matching any address). No address residue present.
purpose: Per-summon VGA palette B (blue) channel bytes for the summon-spell (召喚系) cinematic, indexed by summon_idx = spell_id - 0x20 (0x20..0x23 -> 0..3).
logic_summary: Read-only scalar uint32 holding 4 LE-packed B-channel bytes {3F,3F,00,09} = 0x09003F3F. Sole consumer fd2_execute_summon_spell_cast (@ 0x27FC9) copies the whole 4-byte table into a stack-local dword (palette_B) in one MOV, then byte-indexes that local copy by summon_idx to pick the per-summon blue value, which it feeds into fd2_interpolate_palette_range_toward_color during the strobe and fade phases. The byte-index lives in the consumer on its local dword copy, so the global is a scalar (an array would decay to a pointer at the whole-dword copy). Third of three sibling RGB tables (R @ 0x5254F, G @ 0x52553, B @ 0x52557) immediately preceding the SFX-bank-index table @ 0x5255B.
datatype: uint32 (4-byte dword; 4 VGA B-channel bytes LE-packed)
element_semantics: Each of the 4 packed bytes is the VGA 6-bit blue-channel intensity (0x00..0x3F) for one summon spell, ordered by summon_idx = spell_id - 0x20: byte0=0x3F (0x20 熾天使), byte1=0x3F (0x21 風妖精), byte2=0x00 (0x22 破壞神), byte3=0x09 (0x23 暗邪鬼).
notes: Verified against Ghidra: single xref is a READ at 0x00027fec from fd2_execute_summon_spell_cast (no writer -> is_const true). Memory @ 0x52557 = 3f 3f 00 09 = 0x09003F3F, matches src line 135. Decompile confirms whole-dword load to stack-local palette_B then byte-index by summon_idx on the local copy. Values all <= 0x3F consistent with VGA 6-bit channel. src comment block (btltab2.c lines 115-132) documents all three R/G/B tables together and is already precise and consistent with Ghidra; no change. No separate data plate at 0x52557; the consumer-function plate already documents these tables correctly and consistently, so no plate action.
